title: Speculative Macro Commit for Faster Tool-Using Agents
description:
arXiv:2609.03236v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents spend wall-clock time not only on model inference but also in serial action--observation turns, where each tool call, environment transition, and observation can delay subsequent decisions.
